product.audience: Race fans, prospective partners and paddock members following the team’s competitive method
product.decision: Understand the team’s strategy intelligence, programme and access tiers
product.conversion: Complete a paddock-interest request with a selected membership level

signature.moment: A circuit marker, race clock and three engineering traces move together as the visitor isolates sectors before the pit wall calls a strategy

systems.hero: Broadcast command surface overlaying one race still with timing tower, radio transcript and session status
systems.navigation: Race-control masthead with direct anchors and live session coordinate
systems.contentDensity: Dense operational first half, cinematic team statement, compact season proof and direct conversion
systems.geometry: Timing columns, hard cuts, track traces, asymmetrical broadcast safe zones and red call markers
systems.motion: A car marker and telemetry trace resolve from explicit race-clock, sector and channel input; no pinned film or decorative endless motion
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors simulate a telemetry lap, then run a deterministic tyre, pit-window, weather and traffic strategy call with visible race outcome

structuralDifferences: Hero opens with current radio call and strategy status before the race image
Telemetry collapses into a radio-width track, stacked sector calls and a thumb-controlled race clock
Strategy inputs become four sequential radio prompts rather than a simultaneous desktop control wall
Outcome becomes a sticky-looking but in-flow timing ticket with explicit next and back controls
Season proof becomes a compact classification ledger rather than a broad desktop data strip

artDirection.typography: System neo-grotesk for broadcast headlines and monospace timing labels; narrow numeric columns; no external fonts
artDirection.material: Near-black broadcast glass, warm white timing paper, race red signal, fluorescent chart line and subtle grid noise
artDirection.imageLogic: One original documentary race still establishes place and speed; track, delta and telemetry marks are code-native SVG/CSS
artDirection.microcopy: Box window, undercut, compound life, traffic loss, crossover, radio check and classification language
artDirection.dataHonesty: All telemetry and projections are explicitly labelled fictional demonstration data, not live race information

palettes.name: pit-wall-night
palettes.role: Default dark broadcast world with race-red signal

sections.name: Race control
sections.composition: broadcast still with independent timing and radio rails

sections.name: Strategy call
sections.composition: control wall paired with track trace and resolved call ticket

sections.name: Live telemetry simulation
sections.composition: moving circuit marker, three-sector call strip, engineering trace and explicit race clock

sections.name: Team channel
sections.composition: large transcript cut with role roster

sections.name: Paddock handover
sections.composition: membership signal plus inline credential form

interactions.name: Telemetry track simulation
interactions.input: Select a sector, isolate speed, brake or energy, and step the race clock
interactions.stateChange: Car position, circuit label, trace, headline metric and engineer values update together
interactions.visibleResult: The lap behaves like an operational simulation rather than a static circuit illustration

interactions.name: Pit-wall strategy call
interactions.input: Tyre compound, pit lap, weather and traffic
interactions.stateChange: Projected delta, rejoin position, stint risk and radio call change
interactions.visibleResult: A strategy order such as BOX LAP 24 / MEDIUM appears with an explained outcome

interactions.name: Paddock interest
interactions.stateChange: Selected access tier enters the credential request
interactions.visibleResult: Accessible confirmation returns a fictional paddock reference

assetStrategy: One original AI-generated documentary race still serves only the broadcast hero. All operations graphics remain semantic and code-native for responsiveness and palette resilience.

assets.role: Race-control hero evidence showing car, pit wall and circuit context
assets.focalCrop: Car in lower-right with upper-left broadcast safe area
assets.mobileSafeArea: Car remains visible in the lower center of a shallow crop; the sky becomes the radio-text field

adjacentTemplates.why: Race operations and strategy outcomes replace a three-scene road-car film, trim atelier and test-drive drawer
A live timing surface and compound model replace poster hero, schedule tabs and ticket tiers
Broadcast timing rails and race calls differ from product specimen, anatomy cutaway and gait calibration
No pinned cinematic fund story or portfolio filters; the surface behaves like active race control
Timing hierarchy and strategy controls replace album portrait choreography, audio player and ticket cart
